title: Commute Delay by Mode and Weather
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=ebike:ride OR sourcetype=scooter:trip)
| eval mode=if(sourcetype="ebike:ride","e-bike","e-scooter")
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration, avg(delay_min) as avg_delay, count as trips by mode weather_bucket
| sort mode weather_bucket
description: Compares commute friction across micro-mobility modes under different weather conditions.
value: Mode choice feels intuitive, but a delay matrix makes it easier to decide what really works in poor conditions.
implementation: Track trip duration, delay, and weather bucket for e-bike and scooter commutes; summarize by mode and weather.
visualization: Grouped table of average commute duration and delay by mode and weather.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which ride mode handles different weather best when you are just trying to get somewhere on time.
